messages:
mira: heads-up — found a stable divergence in int8 bring-up for rwr-7B when we prefill very long anchors + RoPE scaling. quick repro below, happens every run :eyes.

mira: repro snippet:
```
python -m tests.kv_repro --model rwr-7B-int8 --anchor_len 70000 --rope_scale 0.75 --prefill_mode anchor
# observed: logits diverge after token 65536, kv index mismatch in logs
```

jon: can you paste the exact error lines from the decoder logs? is it an off-by-one or full-sequence mismatch?

mira: logs (trimmed):
```
[decoder] prefill: wrote kvcache entries 0..65535
[decoder] prefill: expected read at slot 65536 but found tag=0x0f
[model] warning: kv-read mismatch at step 65537, rolling fallback to slow path
```

sasha: interesting. could be RoPE wrap/anchoring interacting with how int8 pack aligns cache pages. try running with rope_scale=1.0 and rope_scale=0.5 to see if shift disappears. also try setting KV_PREFETCH=0 to force on-demand prefill.

reno: ran quick sweep with rope_scale=1.0 and 0.5. results: 1.0 -> no divergence, 0.75 -> diverge, 0.5 -> diverge but later (token ~82000). CP run command I used: `./bin/kv_test --m rwr-7B-int8 --anchor 70000 --rope 0.75 --quant int8`

mira: same here. hypothesis: the scaled rotary phase causes virtual position ids to cross a page boundary, combined with int8 packing padding shifts the memcpy offsets. i think the prefill loop assumes contiguous stride aligned to 64B but quantized layout is 64B+pad.

jon: could also be a shard boundary/tiling bug — if prefill writes partial tile then the read uses a full tile index. sasha, can we add assertions in prefill to validate stride and memalign? quick patch maybe.

sasha: yep i'll add an assert and a short unit that reproduces on CPU with a smaller anchor (e.g., 2048) by simulating the packing. put the minimal repro in a PR and tag me. also add a run toggling `KV_EAGER_PREFILL=1` vs `0`.

mira: created a lightweight repro in /tmp/repros/rwr_kv_anchor_minimal.py and uploaded to the test bucket. linked it in the ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-1258 (WIP).

deploy-bot: canary paused: rwr-7B-int8 canary (zone: us-west-2) - paused automatically due to kv-read mismatch alerts.

jon: good. hold the rollout until we confirm. reno — can you run the packing-inspector on the canary node to dump mmap offsets? will help confirm padding hypothesis.

reno: on it, starting dump now. ETA 12m. will post the mmap table when done. :hammer_and_wrench:

mira: thanks all. next steps: sasha adds assertions + unit, reno posts mmap dump, i'll try a brute-force mitigation (force 64B-aligned allocations for kv pages) and report perf delta. keeping notes here so we can avoid regressions in Dedicated. :memo:
